segments.title: 第171章 露一手
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 171: A Little Demonstration

The afternoon's club activity experience was, in fact, much like the first day of school, with each club setting up a small stall along Houde Road.

Each stall would offer a small game related to the club's activities.

For instance, the Literature Club had various riddles, couplets, and poetry games.

Sports clubs like basketball and badminton were set up on the sports field and basketball courts.

And clubs like the Rock Club were placed directly inside the gymnasium.

The school had given every student a guide booklet, detailing the location of each club's stall.

Students could use it to accurately find the clubs they were interested in and participate in their activities based on their own preferences.

After all, people like Li Luo who would join a club just because they were interested in something were quite rare.

After entering Fuyizhong, most students still prioritized their studies, generally joining one competition club and one interest-based club.

And most of the time, they focused on the activities of the competition club, only occasionally participating in the interest-based one.

The better the student, the more this was the case.

Someone like Li Luo, ranked 15th in the grade yet not participating in a single competition club, was truly a minority among minorities.

"What are you and Qiao Xinyan planning to do later?" Li Luo asked Ying Chanxi, who was sitting beside him behind the Literature Club stall.

To the students of Fuyizhong, the Literature Club was about as niche as it got.

Even a club with few members like the Rock Club was quite popular during the New Year's Gala.

Many people were happy to go and try out an instrument.

But the Literature Club truly had very few visitors.

Only some collectors, aiming to get the stamps from every single club, might wander over to the Literature Club for a look.

But since there was no prize draw for collecting the club stamps in the afternoon, the vast majority of students were just browsing casually.

Some even grabbed a few friends and went to have a picnic on an empty spot on the sports field.

"Xinyan said we could just walk around for a bit first," Ying Chanxi said. "Then when we get tired, she also brought a picnic blanket from home. We can call some friends over to sit on the field for a while. Are you coming later?"

"We'll see," Li Luo thought for a moment. "If things aren't too busy at the Rock Club, I'll find some time to come look for you."

"Okay," Ying Chanxi nodded happily, then pointed to the southwest corner of the sports field behind them. "There are fewer people over there. If we go for a picnic, Xinyan and I will choose a spot under the trees there."

"Alright. If I come, I'll look for you guys over there."

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi chatted idly in the shade of the trees, occasionally attending to students who came by to play.

After about half an hour, the Literature Club members responsible for the next shift came to take over.

"Thank you for your hard work, Class President." Liu Shaowen appeared in front of the Literature Club stall. He and another student had come to take over the next shift of stall duty.

As he came to take over, he looked a bit hesitant, but he still mustered the courage to ask Ying Chanxi, "Class President, do you have any free time this afternoon? If you get tired of walking around, we could find a spot on the field for a picnic together. I brought a lot of snacks, more than I can finish."

After speaking, Liu Shaowen didn't neglect Li Luo at his side, saying to him, "Li Luo can come too, the more the merrier."

"I've already made plans with Qiao Xinyan to hang out this afternoon. You should ask someone else," Ying Chanxi politely declined, then stood up and winked at Li Luo. "I'm going to find Xinyan first, bye-bye."

Li Luo nodded at her, then looked at Liu Shaowen and smiled. "Thanks for the kind offer. We'll leave the stall to you guys."

"Ahem... it's no trouble. You guys go have fun." Liu Shaowen wasn't discouraged. He calmly accepted the failed invitation and sat down in the chair Ying Chanxi had just vacated, feeling a small sense of comfort. "Leave this to us."

Li Luo admired the guy's spirit. After parting ways with Ying Chanxi on the path, he waved and walked toward the gymnasium.

The gymnasium was quite lively at this time.

With Li Luo absent, Qian Siliang from the second year was also away due to matters with another club.

So, for the Rock Club, Niu Qingling, Yan Zhusheng, Xie Shuchen, and Shao Youpeng were the four people busy managing things.

Niu Qingling was in charge of the drum kit experience, Xie Shuchen was on keyboard, Yan Zhusheng was on guitar, and Shao Youpeng was on bass.

Most of the students who came to visit the Rock Club were girls.

This gave both Xie Shuchen and Shao Youpeng a chance to show off.

The girls were all lined up at their stations, curiously trying out the instruments.

Xie Shuchen was especially handsome, so the girls formed a long line, all coming over to learn how to press the keyboard keys.

As for the boys who came to visit, many of them ran over to Yan Zhusheng's station to try the guitar.

Unfortunately, Yan Zhusheng was a bit too serious about these things. The three phrases she most frequently had on her lips were, "You played it wrong," "Not that string," and "Next."

Niu Qingling's station, on the other hand, was rather quiet. After all, most people didn't know much about the drums in a band, let alone have any interest in them.

So Niu Qingling was happy to have the downtime, only showing off her skills when someone occasionally expressed interest.

Just then, Li Luo walked in from outside the gymnasium. Faced with the hopelessly inept students, Yan Zhusheng's eyes immediately lit up the moment she saw Li Luo.

She waved at Li Luo, and he quickly walked over. "You're in charge of the guitar section, right?"

"Yeah," Yan Zhusheng nodded, then said in a small, troubled voice, "But they're all so clumsy, not as smart as you."

"None of them have ever learned guitar before," Li Luo shook his head with a helpless smile. "Don't be too demanding."

"I'm tired."

"Let me take over," Li Luo said. "Go hang out with Xu Yinghuan and the others, or go find Xixi. She said she might go for a picnic on the field later when she gets tired of walking."

"I'll stay here and keep you company," Yan Zhusheng had no intention of leaving. She stood next to Li Luo, simply handing over the task of teaching people to play the guitar.

To be honest, Yan Zhusheng was just a bit too serious about music, but in reality, most of the boys lining up were there for her looks.

Seeing that these people weren't genuinely interested in learning, Yan Zhusheng felt a little angry, though no one could tell from her expression.

Now that Li Luo was taking over, she could finally rest for a bit. So she sat down next to Li Luo and watched him teach others to play the guitar.

However, the group of boys who were originally in line immediately scattered once they saw Yan Zhusheng was no longer teaching.

On the other hand, some of the girls waiting nearby began whispering to each other after Li Luo appeared, and a few of them ran over to get in line.

Among them was Shen Shuhua from Class 16.

"Li Luo, we meet again," Shen Shuhua was pushed forward by her classmates and soon arrived at the front of the line in front of Li Luo, greeting him with a shy smile.

"Oh, it's you," Li Luo glanced up at her, then handed her a guitar. "Go ahead."

The lesson was very simple, just teaching them how to play "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star," or "Two Tigers."

At their request, Li Luo would also show off a little from time to time.

Li Luo didn't pay much attention to Shen Shuhua's situation. After teaching her, he called for the next person.

After leaving the gymnasium, Shen Shuhua was surrounded by her friends from the same class, laughing and teasing each other on the path.

"So, how did it feel? Didn't you say you like boys with a talent for music the most?"

"He's very charming, you know. Didn't you guys notice? Li Luo is different from the other two boys over there."

"True, the other two guys love to show off too much... how should I put it... it's like they're intentionally flaunting their ability to play keyboard and bass."

"Yes, yes! Now that you mention it, I realize those two are always showing off their skills. Only Li Luo was teaching patiently, and he would only reluctantly play a more complex piece when he was begged to."

"His personality is so nice too, not as childish as those other two."

"Aren't you tempted, Xiao Shu? I'm even a little tempted."

"But..." Shen Shuhua said helplessly, "That girl next to him seems to be on pretty good terms with him, right?"

"Don't worry, I already asked around in Class 8," one of the girls said. "There was a rumor before that Li Luo was dating that girl, but it was later confirmed that it wasn't true. Anyway, why don't you just give it a try and find out?"

"You guys are really something..." Shen Shuhua smiled shyly. "I never said I was going to do anything."

Li Luo was completely unaware of this, simply taking Yan Zhusheng's place to teach them guitar.

After about half an hour, Yan Zhusheng took his place again, letting him rest on the side for a while.

At this moment, Xu Youyu wandered over to the gymnasium. She walked in, took a look around, and spotted Li Luo slacking off.

"What are you doing?"

"Taking a break," Li Luo said. "How about you, Senior? Are you on patrol?"

"You haven't had any emergencies here, have you?"

"We have."

"Huh? What happened?"

"President, your grand arrival. How is that not an emergency?" Li Luo smiled and asked, "Senior, would you like to give it a try?"

"I don't think I need to. I still have to check on other places."

"What does it matter? It won't take much time."

"But there are people lining up over there. I can't just cut in line, can I?"

"There's no one at the drum kit."

"You know how to play that too?"

"Senior, you're underestimating me a little," Li Luo gestured to her. "Come on, I'll give you a little demonstration."

(End of Chapter)
